stays.note: Family home, 5 avenue de Beaulieu, Asnieres, with his studio in the garden (since autumn 1887)
Left for Saint-Briac 23 Apr, arrived 25 Apr; small house attached to Mrs Lemasson's inn; until c. 10 Aug
Arrived 8 or 10 Aug (Gauguin to Schuffenecker 14 Aug: 'Young Bernard is here'); left for Paris c. 10 Nov

evidence: inferred: edition says 'back in Paris since about 10 November'; Vincent treated 5 avenue de Beaulieu (Asnieres) as Bernard's 'address in Paris' (let698). No letters in this span

stays.note: Edition: 'in Paris from September to December 1889'; the family home was at Asnieres (let698 n.16), so this may in fact be Asnieres

let599.note: Bernard found this letter waiting on his arrival in Saint-Briac on 25 April 1888
